name: Waveshare ESP32-S3 ePaper 1.54 V2 BSP (No Affiliation With Waveshare)

specs.RAM: 512 KB Internal SRAM, 8 MB External Octal PSRAM (80 MHz)
specs.Flash: 8 MB Quad SPI Flash (80 MHz, QIO Mode)
specs.Audio Codec: ES8311 I2S Audio Codec + NS4168 Power Amplifier
specs.Power PMU: AXP2101 PMU / Battery Voltage Fuel Gauge

description: Unified Board Support Package for the Waveshare ESP32-S3 ePaper 1.54 V2 platform (ESP32-S3-PICO-1-N8R8). Provides turnkey display drivers, power management, BLE GATT provisioning, sensors, and hardware optimizations.
shortDescription: ESP32-S3 ePaper 1.54 V2 Board Support Package for ESP-IDF and LVGL v9.
